tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.title: List supported conversion formats
tools.description: Returns the categories of files BH KONVER can convert (documents, spreadsheets, presentations, images, audio, video) and the file extensions each category supports.

module.description: Optional. Restrict result to a single module.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.title: Get BH KONVER pricing plans
tools.description: Returns available BH KONVER premium subscription plans with duration and price in BAM (billed in EUR via PayPal).

tools.name: list_legal_documents
tools.title: List available legal documents
tools.description: Returns the BiH-compliant legal statement templates available in the 'Pravni dokumenti' section, grouped by category. All PDFs are generated client-side (privacy-first).

category.description: Optional. Restrict to a single category.
